title: Band Akhiyan Kaar Na Kaway Bhain Teri, Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay
body:
May Vaindee Raiyaan Haar Zarb Teri (x2) Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Noh Lakh Dha Majma, Meray Khullay Vaal Ay
Abid Toh Puchlay Turna Muhaal Ay (x2)
Teri Sohni Nibhgaye Hun Waari Meri (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri.
<<DIVIDER>>
Paidal Turha Kay, Usnu Lay Aawo
Puchda Yazid Ay Mainu Daswo (x2)
Es Kafilay Vich Zainab Hay Kairi (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Fizza Day Waris, Vi Aaye Nana
Zainab Dah Waris Aaya Koyi Nah (x2)
Sirr Nangay Rondhi Raye Dhee Hay Teri (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chelum Manawan, Karbal Ch Aayi
Ghaal La Kabar Nu Kaway Zahra Jaayi (x2)
Dus Kiwain Ujri Hay Behn Teri (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haar Jah Tay Veeran, Pathaar May Khaandi
Girr Jaanda Abid Us Nu Uthandi (x2)
Oh Bheer Gaye Ay Veeran Batheri (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri.
<<DIVIDER>>
Enjh Hassan Lutiya, Zahra Da Ghaar Ay
Ghoray Day Ghal Vich Ghazi Da Saar Ay (x2)
Dasan Museebat May Kairi Kairi (x2)
Ay Shaam Bangaye Maqtal Hay Meri
